name: freshness
description: Freshness boundary and unknown Cache-Control directives.

/clock.content: Clock body used for the freshness boundary tests.

/directives.content: Unknown directives are ignored; max-age is honoured.

/zero.content: max-age=0 is never fresh, not even at the receive instant.

/nomax.content: No max-age: stored only for revalidation, never served fresh.
